body:
maya: Heads up — noticed a handful of resumed streaming sessions showing provisional token entries that never reconciled to confirmed, result: customers seeing provisional spike on console.
ryan: repro steps?
maya: capture: request_id=ab12, route=fallback-eu, original_route=primary-us, reason=kv-evict+reconnect
maya: logs:
```
2026-03-10T12:01:23Z req=ab12 state=resume provisional_tokens=24 confirmed_tokens=null fallback=true
```
zara: UI normally flips provisional -> confirmed after final ack. Is this a replay or missing final ack?
leif: looks like a toolcall was attached mid-stream; on resume we drop the toolcall suffix so attribution/truncation mismatch happens. Tokens that belong to the toolcall suffix never get confirmed.
maya: suggestion: add `finalized_at` and `billing_route`/`quota_route` to internal accounting rows and surface provisional/confirmed in the console as two separate metrics.
ryan: counter: exposing both might freak customers out. Can we instead improve telemetry and auto-reconcile within 1 minute?
zara: for UX, we could show a subtle "provisional" pill with hover explainer + link to billing details, not the main metric.
ops-bot: alert: billing-inconsistency spike 2026-03-10T12:01 — provisional>confirmed +0.18% across EU fallback pool
leif: technical fix idea: on resume, rehydrate both prefix + KV cache and the toolcall metadata; if toolcall metadata differs, compute final token delta by diffing last-ack offsets and attach to confirmed.
maya: also need to decide routing attribution — attribute to original route (where request started) or final route (where tokens were actually consumed)? Quotas and dashboards diverge depending on choice.
ryan: billing team prefers attributing to the final executed route so invoices match consumed capacity. Quota enforcement team prefers original route for fairness (apps expecting consumption from primary).
zara: proposal: attribute billing to final model/route, but keep quota charge tied to original route unless router explicitly rewrites the route. Display both in the console.
leif: that doubles up fields in the ledger but is doable: add `billing_route` and `quota_route` fields, default to same value. Reconciliation job can backfill where mismatch occurred.
maya: low-risk rollout: feature-flag `billing_route=final` for 5% traffic and monitor provisional->confirmed drift + cost deltas.
ryan: add dashboard: provisional_vs_confirmed ratio by route + trace link to request_id. Also show per-route charge delta for experiment traffic.
zara: I'll mock the pill and hover text, include the link to trace and a one-line explainer for "why provisional exists".
maya: I'll open RFC INF-1142 with sample logs and rollout plan, will assign to eng-platform.
leif: follow-up: SRE to schedule an hourly aggregation job that finds provisional > confirmed and triggers auto-reconcile. Also log request_id and last-ack for traceability.
ryan: SGTM :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — INF-1142 created, attached 5 sample request_ids (ab12, cd34, ef56, gh78, ij90). Will start the 5% rollout after the RFC is approved.
zara: cool, snapshot UX mock in the ticket. If we see regressions we can roll the flag back quickly.
maya: filing postmortem template in the ticket in case we need it.
zara: good call — saves time if we need to escalate.
